verdict.rationale: Baseten ships a first-party skill and official MCP servers so a coding agent can manage the Baseten workspace and search the docs. This lets users operate the product through natural-language prompts to an agent, though it relies on an external agent rather than a native natural-language interface. The evidence is a single-line description with no detail on which workspace operations are exposed. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product, documented scope of agent-manageable operations (deploy, scale, train, billing), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
